name: Tamadaco Data Center Toamasina
notes: Tamadaco publishes a DATA CENTER product/page and lists a Madagascar office address at 03 Behind Voirie Cite Nouvelle, 501 Toamasina. The page supports data-center activity in Toamasina, but does not provide facility capacity, launch date, certification, or technical details.

name: Telma/Yas Data Center Diego-Suarez
notes: Search results and public profile snippets reference work at a Telma data center in Diego-Suarez/Antsiranana; Telma has rebranded consumer services as Yas. No primary facility page, address, or capacity was found during this pass, so the record is retained as unverified activity rather than a no-project line.

name: Stellarix TNR1 Analakely
notes: Stellarix identifies itself as an AXIAN Telecom subsidiary based in Madagascar and lists TNR1 Analakely at Lalana Paul Dussac, Antananarivo 101. AXIAN describes Stellarix as Madagascar's first private neutral datacenter business and cites 450 racks and 1,400 kW in production by 2023 across the Stellarix platform.

name: Stellarix TNR2 Galaxy
notes: Stellarix lists TNR2 Galaxy at Building KUBE D, 2nd floor, Galaxy Andraharo, BP 763, Antananarivo 101. The same source says Stellarix operates two Tier III-ready data centers; AXIAN provides platform-level rack and production-power figures but not a per-site capacity split.

name: Yas Data Center Toliary
notes: DataCenterMap lists a Yas Data Center in Toliary/Toliara. The operator site confirms Yas Madagascar as the current Telma brand, but no official public facility page with capacity or technical specification was found during this pass.
